purpose: Verify host-executed visual QA on previously missed portfolio evidence using current tools, not an end-to-end performance comparison.

evaluation_tasks.scope: Inspect both supplied images independently, six visual axes; current Figma identity applies only to screen-b; missing prior source remains unknown.
Inspect fixed-viewport captures, compare same components with Figma, document actual image dimensions versus CSS and source-version boundaries.

acceptance: Find the six preregistered clipped locations in screen-a; grouping repeated locations into one cause is allowed.
Do not mark known readable OUTPUT/INPUT/INPRO text as clipped.
Report the confirmed Figma/web font and composition differences as scoped differences, without inventing intent or treating Figma itself as infallible.
Include observed positions and image evidence for each material finding; unknown states do not pass.
Existing visual gate rejects bare passed receipts and recomputes actual/reference pixel_diff.
limits: Known failure regression authored after prior incident; not a held-out sample.
Single product; no general recall/precision claim.
Static screenshots do not prove touch flow, current Safari render, physical devices, or accessibility certification.
